entities.summary: Hassan Pirnia, titled Moshir-od-Dowleh, was a prominent politician of 20th-century Iran. He held a total of twenty-four posts during his political career, serving four times as Prime Minister of Iran. He was also a historian, co-founding the Society for the National Heritage of Iran.
